comment:baseUrl: There is deliberately no baseUrl. It is deprecated and stops working in TypeScript 7, and while it was set tsc raised TS5101 — a config-level error, which aborts before a single file is type-checked, so `tsc --noEmit` reported nothing but that one line and appeared to pass. Under moduleResolution 'bundler' the paths below resolve relative to this file and need no baseUrl.
comment:exclude: n8n/ is n8n Workflow SDK source, not app code. It is authored against @n8n/workflow-sdk, which lives inside n8n's own builder and is never installed here, so type-checking it would fail the build.
